data.name: Bhaskara
data.gender_notes: Bhaskara is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhaskara is derived from the Sanskrit word Bhaskara, which means radiant, shining, or knowledgeable. In Hindu mythology, Bhaskara is the name of the Sun God, Surya. It is believed that the name bestows wisdom, brilliance, and the ability to light up the path for others. The name Bhaskara carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining, Knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhaskara usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining, knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes enlightenment and the illumination of the mind.
data.etymology: Bhaskara belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, Shining, Knowledgeable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhaskara total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bhaskara has a rich cultural significance in Hinduism and ancient Indian literature. Bhaskara was the name of several famous mathematicians, scholars, and philosophers. For instance, Bhaskaracharya is known to have written the important mathematical text "Lilavati". This shows that the name reflects intellectual brilliance and a deep connection with knowledge and wisdom.
data.spiritual_significance: Bhaskara is also a devotional name for the Sun God, Surya. The Sun is considered the provider of life and energy, and it is associated with prosperity, power, and auspiciousness. The spiritual significance of the name Bhaskara is that it brings about the blessings of the Sun God, symbolizing illumination, knowledge, and prosperity. It is believed to ignite the inner light within an individual and help them shine both internally and externally.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bhaskara: Radiating knowledge and light like the Sun God, Bhaskar signifies the inner illumination of wisdom and enlightenment in one's soul. It symbolizes the pursuit of truth and the sharing of knowledge to brighten the path for others.
